decisions.reason: The modular plant concept builds on the firm's core environmental-technology know-how and has a quantified customer saving of over 600,000 euros a year, so the firm can read the early results as positive and refine the product through its own R&D.
The slow-speed shredder sits squarely in the firm's established competence and has its own web page, so it is easy to assimilate, service and improve with existing knowledge.

As a multi-model flagship line that extends the firm's modular direction, it draws directly on accumulated know-how and research cooperation, so management will keep developing it rather than drop it.
The mobile trommel screen is close to the firm's core offer and fits its service and telematics network, so it is low risk and easy to learn from and refine.
